command:
cat > /tmp/gdbtest3.cmd <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
target remote localhost:1234
break src/task/mod.rs:173
commands
  silent
  printf "END-OF-RUN\n"
  quit
end
set $n = 0
break os::mm::page_table::PageTable::map
commands
  silent
  set $n = $n + 1
  if $n <= 3
    printf "map hit #%d\n", $n
  end
  if $n == 3
    disable $_hit_bpnum
  end
  continue
end
continue
EOF
cd /home/starryreverie/userdata/development/rCore-Tutorial-Code-2026A && /tmp/gdbrun.sh /tmp/gdbtest3.cmd 300 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\[rustsbi\]" | tail -15; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
